t: MySmartBlinds adds window automation | AppMyHome
s: April 17, 2020 - Thus far, we have concluded that there is currently no cost effective way to automate our existing shades and shutters. At CES 2017, we discovered MySmartBlinds, who have a product to automate tilting of venetian blinds. They sell both complete blinds with a tilt motor, and retrofit kits for those who already have venetian blinds installed.
